english.title: Provide flight information service other than in accordance with manual
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) provided a flight information service at the

(A)_[aerodrome]_
(B)_[area control centre]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)

(C)_[other than in accordance with the standards and procedures specified in the flight information service manual for that aerodrome]_
(D)_[other than in accordance with the standards and procedures specified in the flight information service manual for that area control centre]_
(E)_[when the flight information service manual was not produced to the CAA within a reasonable time after a request for its production was made by the CAA]_
(F)_[when amendments or additions had not been made to the flight information service manual as the CAA required]_

in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 201 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
provided a flight information service at the aerodrome or area control centre
other than in accordance with the standards and procedures specified in the flight information service manual for that aerodrome or area control centre OR
when the flight information service manual was not produced to the CAA within a reasonable time after a request for its production was made by the CAA OR
when amendments or additions had not been made to the flight information service manual as the CAA required
